Hero.text: You see, but you do not observe, Watson. Every clock in this shop was stopped by hand, and whoever stopped them meant us to notice it.
Hero.description: 一位三十多岁的英国绅士，标准英式英语口音（RP），维多利亚时代伦敦上流社会的说话方式。声音清亮、精准的男中音，语速偏快，咬字干脆利落，略带冷幽默。

Watson.text: I had seen little of Holmes lately. That evening the fog lay thick upon Baker Street, and I sat by the fire with yesterday's paper, quite content.
Watson.description: A retired British army surgeon in 1890s London, middle-class English, speaking old-fashioned, well-spoken English English. About forty, warm, deep and reassuring.

Mrs Hudson.text: There's a young gentleman waiting downstairs, Mr Holmes, and he won't take no for an answer. Soaked through, poor lamb, and white as a sheet.
Mrs Hudson.description: 一位六十多岁快七十岁的英国老妇人，维多利亚时代伦敦的房东太太，带伦敦本地口音。声音苍老、略细，但开朗活泼、精神十足，说话轻快利索，热心又慈祥。

Toby.text: I've run all the way from Clerkenwell, sir, honest I have. The guv'nor's gone, and the shop's bolted up tight, and I don't know who else to ask.
Toby.description: Accent: strong Cockney, a working-class East London boy of the 1890s. A young boy of about twelve with a high, unbroken child's voice. Out of breath, frightened and urgent.
